policy_title:
Lung Cancer Screening with Low Dose
Computed Tomography (LDCT)

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for prostate cancer screening when appropriately reported. 
Appropriate reporting includes 
• 
Reporting the screening CPT code or counseling HCPCS code for patients 50 years of age 
or older 
• 
Reporting the screening CPT code or counseling HCPCS code with a diagnosis indicating 
nicotine dependence 
• 
Reporting the screening CPT code no more than once per year by any provider 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
The screening CPT code or counseling HCPCS code is reported for patients 49 years of 
age or younger 
• 
The screening CPT code or counseling HCPCS code is not reported with a diagnosis 
indicating nicotine dependence 
• 
The screening CPT code is reported more than once per year by any provider 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT, HCPCS code(s), 
ICD-10-CM codes and modifiers reported.

Applicable CPT Code

contrast material(s)

CT scan (LDCT)
